entities.name: Relno
entities.description: A nervous inventor-mage who lives in a tower on an island lab and asks his noble backer Emina for money to finish his greatest work.

entities.name: Emina
entities.description: A noble who backs Relno's work and whose family he made wealthy and powerful.

entities.name: Zurbit
entities.description: Relno's faithful one-eyed homunculus who avenges the ransacking of the tower by merfolk.

entities.name: Pip
entities.description: Relno's orange-striped cat, whom Zurbit enlarges with a potion to a whale-sized size.

entities.name: Merfolk raiders
entities.description: A small group of merfolk living on a reef offshore who rob land-dwellers along the Kapsho.

entities.name: Relno's tower
entities.description: Relno's tall tower laboratory on an island, ransacked by merfolk.

entities.name: Martyne
entities.description: Place from which pieces of Relno's work will be shipped.

entities.name: Kapsho
entities.description: Waters whose shores the merfolk raid.

events.summary: Relno firmly asks the noble Emina for more money and she agrees to five thousand.
Relno sails home eager to finish his greatest work, planning elementals and a shipment from Martyne.
events.quote: Finally, he had the funds he needed to finish his greatest work—it would be glorious.

events.summary: Zurbit discovers the tower ransacked and a window pried open by merfolk.
events.quote: They had made off with the lot.

events.summary: Zurbit rows to the merfolk reef with Pip and drops a message in a flask.
events.quote: He stuffed the message into a flask and made sure that it could be read.

events.summary: A merfolk surfaces and hisses at Zurbit with contempt.
events.quote: The merfolk's eyes were cold and smug as it submerged under the waves with a final hiss of contempt.

events.summary: Zurbit gives Pip a green potion and pushes him out over the reef as the cat grows to the size of a small whale.
events.quote: Then he began to row with all his might, as Pip grew to the size of a small whale.

events.summary: Relno returns to find the tower in disarray; Zurbit claims he was just letting in some sea air.
events.quote: "Just letting in a little sea air."

relations.note: They robbed the tower and he takes revenge.
relations.quote: these finny folk were robbers and cutthroats

relations.note: Relno relies on Emina's financial backing.
relations.quote: He was the one whose genius made her family wealthy and powerful.
